choice.basis: The chart title is refuted as authoritative because it contradicts the plotted data (e.g., production fell from 2018 to 2019). The endpoint comparison (r3) is supported: 2023 production (2,600) is lower than 2018 (2,800), and since the y-axis increases upward, this constitutes a decline. The recent stability observation (r1) is not sufficient to override the endpoint-based decline classification, as the policy conditions for r3 explicitly prioritize endpoint change over recent volatility. Therefore, the decline route is the only supported option.
